name: Grok Voice
description: xAI's real-time voice conversation model with low-latency audio input and output streaming.

websocket.description: Enable real-time WebSocket connection for voice conversations. When true, establishes a bidirectional WebSocket for speech-to-speech interaction with Grok voice models.

url.description: WebSocket URL for the realtime connection (e.g., wss://...)

headers.description: Optional headers to include when establishing the WebSocket connection (e.g., Authorization)
